# G502 X PLUS through the LIGHTSPEED receiver (USB 046D:C547), captured
# 2026-11-20 with hidapi 2.6.7 by a throwaway program reading both HID++
# collections. RX = long collection, RXS = short collection.
# root getFeature(0x8100) sent to device index 2, where nothing is paired:
# HID++ 1.0 error 0x08 (unknown device) from the receiver, on the short collection
TX 11 02 00 0E 81 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RXS 10 02 8F 00 0E 08 00
# onboard profiles function 0xF, which does not exist: HID++ 2.0 error 0x07 (invalid function)
TX 11 01 0B FE 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RX 11 01 FF 0B FE 07 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
# device name getName(offset 0x10), past the 11-character name: HID++ 2.0 error 0x02 (invalid argument)
TX 11 01 03 1E 10 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RX 11 01 FF 03 1E 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
# root ping sent to device index 0xFF, which addresses the receiver itself:
# HID++ 1.0 error 0x01 (invalid sub ID). The error was captured by
# `palaswitch-cli sniff` during a discovery, 2026-11-20; the TX line is the
# request that discovery sends.
TX 11 FF 00 1E 00 00 AA 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RXS 10 FF 8F 00 1E 01 00
# mouse switched off with its power switch, cable unplugged, 2026-11-20:
# the receiver answers HID++ 1.0 error 0x08 (unknown device), the same as
# after about two minutes of deep sleep
TX 11 01 00 1E 00 00 AA 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RXS 10 01 8F 00 1E 08 00
TX 11 01 0B 3E 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
RXS 10 01 8F 0B 3E 08 00
